{
  "name": "quota-guard",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Compacts before the 5-hour/weekly usage limit is hit, pauses until it resets, then resumes the task automatically.",
  "userConfig": {
    "threshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "5-hour threshold (%)",
      "description": "Compact and pause when 5-hour usage reaches this percentage.",
      "default": 94,
      "min": 50,
      "max": 99
    },
    "weeklyThreshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Weekly threshold (%)",
      "description": "Compact and pause when weekly usage reaches this percentage.",
      "default": 97,
      "min": 50,
      "max": 100
    },
    "weeklyPolicy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Weekly limit policy",
      "description": "pause = pause until the weekly reset; notify = only warn.",
      "default": "pause"
    },
    "abortThreshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Abort running turn at (%)",
      "description": "Interrupt a running turn at this usage instead of waiting for it to finish.",
      "default": 98,
      "min": 60,
      "max": 100
    },
    "graceSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Grace after reset (s)",
      "description": "Wait this long past the reported reset time before re-checking.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 600
    },
    "maxResumeAttempts": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max resume attempts",
      "description": "Stop auto-resuming after this many failed attempts per pause.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 20
    },
    "notifyAt": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Heads-up at (%)",
      "description": "One toast when a window first reaches this usage. 0 disables.",
      "default": 80,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 99
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "description": "Automatic quota management on or off.",
      "default": true
    },
    "testMode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test / dry-run mode",
      "description": "Use simulated usage (/quota sim ...) and dry-run actions instead of real quota.",
      "default": false
    },
    "compactMinContext": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Compact only above context (%)",
      "description": "At the quota threshold, compact first only if the context window is fuller than this; otherwise just wait for the reset.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100
    },
    "idleCompact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Idle compaction",
      "description": "While waiting on background work, compact shortly before the prompt cache expires to avoid re-sending a large context at full price.",
      "default": true
    },
    "idleCompactMinTokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Idle compaction minimum (tokens)",
      "description": "Only compact while idle when the context is at least this many tokens.",
      "default": 200000,
      "min": 20000,
      "max": 1000000
    },
    "cacheTtlMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Prompt-cache lifetime (minutes)",
      "description": "60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute cache.",
      "default": 60,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 120
    },
    "idleMarginSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Compact this early (seconds)",
      "description": "How long before the cache would expire to compact.",
      "default": 180,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1800
    },
    "idleRequiresBackground": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Idle compaction only while waiting on background work",
      "description": "Off (default): compact any idle session shortly before the prompt cache expires. On: only when a background command, monitor or agent is pending.",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "catsmonster"
  }
}
